bottleneck_observation: Flow 2 limited to 14.3 Mbps by narrow s6-s13 link (15 Mbps capacity). OSPF shortest-path routing forces this flow through the bottleneck.
ppo_advantage: PPO+GNN can learn to route Flow 2 through wider bypass links (e.g., s6->s14(80Mbps)->s11(15Mbps)->... or s6->s5(150Mbps)->...), achieving higher throughput by avoiding narrow bottlenecks.
